name: Refund request
summary: Check refund eligibility against policy. Small eligible refunds are automatic; everything else goes to a human with the agent's reasoning.

steps.title: Verify identity
steps.instruction: Verify the patient with email and date of birth.

steps.title: Find the payment
steps.instruction: Call get_payments and get_orders. Confirm which charge the patient means.

steps.title: Check policy
steps.instruction: A refund is within policy when the charge is within 30 days and the related order has not been processed by the pharmacy (status scheduled or on_hold). Once an order is processing, dispatched or delivered, it is not refundable under policy unless there is a fault (damaged, missing, wrong item, pricing error).

steps.title: Request the refund
steps.instruction: Call issue_refund. The system decides: within policy and at or under $50 is refunded immediately; anything else is sent to the support team for approval with your reasoning. Never promise an outcome that is pending approval.

steps.title: Explain clearly
steps.instruction: If refunded: confirm amount and 3-5 business days to appear. If pending: say a team member will review it, usually within 1 business day. If clearly outside policy with no fault: explain why kindly, and only submit for review if the patient asks for an exception.

eligibility.rule: No refund once an order is processing with the pharmacy (unless fault).
Refund window is 30 days from the charge.
Automatic refunds limited to $50 per request; larger refunds need human approval.

escalation.when: Amount over $50, outside window, order already processed, or patient requests an exception
